stem: A recurring finding begins soon after outside plant material is introduced, but quarantine records are incomplete. What is the strongest process concern?
choices: The missing intake/quarantine evidence makes it difficult to evaluate whether incoming material was a transfer pathway
The new material is proven to be the cause
Quarantine records are unnecessary when plants look healthy
The established crop should be relabeled
rationale: Incomplete quarantine records weaken traceability and prevent a confident assessment of the incoming-material pathway.
